{{Quote|It broke when we evacuated the Princess of Quanducial down the palace wall!|Thame Cerulian's comment on a malfunctioning grappling hook in ''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force''|<ref name="The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref>}}
At some point during the last [[Standard year/Legends|century]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Princess of Quanducial]] had to be '''evacuated''' from her residence. One of the overseers of the evacution was [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Thame Cerulian]], who helped the [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] escape by lowering her down the wall of a palace with a [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]]. Despite having the tested breaking point of 550 [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]], however, the device broke during the attempt. Cerulian later recorded the event in his copy of the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] [[Book/Legends|guidebook]] ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''.<ref name="TJP" />
